description: CDC-Cunsultazione citatina in quantu à a 5G in Corsica / Consultation citoyenne relative au déploiement de la 5G en Corse is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Collectivité de Corse. La Collectivité de Corse a mené de janvier à mars 2022 une consultation citoyenne en ligne relative au déploiement de la 5G en Corse. Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Digital and Telecommunications. The portal shows 12,430 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-09-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
